preconditions.expression: all(3 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip()) and all(0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= min(int(line.split()[0]) * (int(line.split()[0]) - 1) // 2, 10**5) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: The first line contains integers n (3 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and m (0 ≤ m ≤ min(n(n-1)/2, 10^5)), where n is the number of vertices and m is the number of edges. The graph has no loops or parallel edges.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == 1 + m and all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly m+1 lines: the first line with n and m, followed by m lines each describing an edge as two integers a_i and b_i (1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(a != b for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: No edge in the input connects a vertex to itself (no loops) and no two edges connect the same pair of vertices (no parallel edges).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == f'{t} {w}' and t >= 0 and w >= 0
postconditions.description: The output consists of two space-separated integers t and w, where t is the minimum number of edges to add to form a simple odd-length cycle (t ≥ 0), and w is the number of ways to add t edges to achieve this (w ≥ 0).

postconditions.expression: t == 0 and w == 1 if any(len(connected_components) == 1 and any(cycle_length % 2 == 1 and cycle_length > 1 for cycle_length in get_all_cycles(adjacency_list))) else t == min_edges_to_odd_cycle(adjacency_list) and w == count_ways_to_add_edges(adjacency_list, t)
postconditions.description: If the graph already contains a simple odd-length cycle (length > 1), then t = 0 and w = 1. Otherwise, t is the minimum number of edges to add to form such a cycle, and w is the number of distinct sets of edges that can be added to achieve this. The cycle must be simple (no repeated vertices) and of odd length > 1.

postconditions.expression: t == 0 or (t == 1 and w == count_possible_odd_cycles_with_one_edge_added(adjacency_list)) or (t == 2 and w == count_possible_odd_cycles_with_two_edges_added(adjacency_list)) or (t == 3 and w == 1)
postconditions.description: The possible values for t are 0 (cycle exists), 1 (can form a cycle by adding one edge), 2 (can form a cycle by adding two edges), or 3 (must add three edges to form a triangle). For t=3, there is exactly one way (adding any three edges forming a triangle). For t=1 or t=2, w counts the number of distinct edge sets that can be added to form such a cycle.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()) if t > 0 else True
postconditions.description: If t > 0, the added edges must connect distinct vertices (no loops or parallel edges).
